notes.title: Important Update for Super Trunko Go followers
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
Thank you all for your continued support.


I would like to relay some issues that I have currently been experiencing. 
I have hit quite a number of obstacles with trying to get the controller to connect 
without problems. I have therefore made the difficult decision to release the 
game on Steam for keyboard/ mouse and Steam Deck play only.

I apologise to anyone who was looking forward to a controller experience,
which leads me to remind that we have a publisher working on the console 
versions (Switch, Xbox, Playstation) and are expected to be released later 
in the year.  Stay tuned!
